extraction.notes: Three-month column taken from the trailing five quarters table (seq 34, printed 13); seq 35 (printed 14) repeats the same three-month figures. IRT reports no AFFO, so affo fields are null. Core metric is named CFFO. Gain on sale of real estate associated with unconsolidated entities is '—' for Q3 2026 and recorded as 0. 'Other loss' is a non-real-estate item with no matching category, so it is recorded as 'other'. Checks: 25,719 + 65,300 + 886 - 26,474 = 65,431 FFO; 65,431 + 5,283 = 70,714 CFFO. Shares: 241,365,153 / 1,000 = 241,365.153; FFO/share 65,431/241,365 = 0.27 and CFFO/share 70,714/241,365 = 0.29, both matching. Recurring capex is from the seq 7 (printed 4) Capital Expenditures paragraph, $10.2 million for the quarter across the total portfolio; it is recorded as 10,200 (thousands) because the source gives only $0.1 million precision. The $304 per unit figure is not used.
